last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 13
last_episode_to_air.overview: Aslı finds herself cornered enough to sit at the marriage table with Serkan; just as the signatures are about to be made, things take an unexpected turn. Returning home, Aslı is forced to confess everything she's kept hidden up to this day to both her siblings and to Aras, who has rushed to Istanbul. The harsh confrontation between the two evolves into something entirely different with Aslı's panic attack; this time, Aras chooses to stay by Aslı's side. Meanwhile, as Hülya grapples with the guilt from Melike's death and traces the footsteps of the past, Reyhan meets with a lawyer to leave the house in Ada to Aslı. The revelation that Melike was adopted cracks open the door to a major family secret kept hidden for years. Aslı, drawing closer to the truth about Meryem's death, comes face to face with Cahit; this moment when she's face to face with death and the uncertainty of Aslı's fate drag the story into a path that's hard to turn back from for all the characters.

name: Reborn
overview: Aslı Güneş has never truly lived her fragile heart kept her trapped in survival. When she finally receives a life-saving transplant, her second chance comes with a price: the heart belonged to Melike Alkan, heir to one of Istanbul’s most powerful families. Drawn into the Alkan world of wealth, grief, and buried secrets, Aslı becomes both a daughter to a grieving mother and the forbidden love of a restless heir. But while she embraces this new life, her own mother and a dangerous lover scheme to exploit her miracle. Torn between two families, two identities, and one borrowed heart, Aslı must discover who she truly is before love, betrayal, and destiny consume her.
tagline: Anneni seçme şansın olsaydı… Yine de onu mu seçerdin?
